dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Is this interpretation based on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I use the Crafting Bench here?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Ah, sure, go ahead. I was thinking about something else anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Lately, I've been studying something called "Alchemical Divination."

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: You rely on intuition to randomly choose some things to conduct alchemy on. If it fails — and, of course, most of the time it does fail — the ashes are used in divination.

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: It's pretty much the same principle as divination of coffee grounds or leftover tea leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: I've noticed that the girls in my class are really interested in that sort of thing, so there's no reason that Alchemical Divination shouldn't be just as popular, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Ugh, but why?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this a personal interest or is it purely academic?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Ahem... Can't it be both?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: My mentor kept shaking their head after I said that according to legend, Alchemical Divination was invented by Lesser Lord Kusanali. But I don't think it's time to give up yet.

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: I just need to work out the rationale for this interpretation, even the tiniest one. Then I can go back and discuss it with my mentor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this interest personal or academic?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Ahem... Can't it be both?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: When I said that "legends hold that this was invented by Lesser Lord Kusanali," my mentor did have a doubtful look, but I didn't get rejected outright, so I reckon that it's too early to give up yet!

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: I just need to work out some rationale for this interpretation, even if it's a flimsy one. Then I can go back and discuss it with my mentor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: Well... Is this what the bad omen that I read today meant?

dialogues.speaker: Kimiya
dialogues.text: I won, haha! If only I could perform divination using Genius Invokation TCG cards...
